text:
pagerbot: HIGH: TridentHealth (tenant_id: trd-993) – elevated 5xx rate on dedicated pool dpool-43 serving model gpt-med-v1.4-quant. Threshold breach at 2026-02-15T10:42:58Z. Paginate: severity=high, page=oncall-sre

maya (oncall-sre): acknowledge. I'm on it. pulling logs now.

samira (eng-runtime): seeing increased KV cache misses + OOM churn on nodes in dpool-43. Symptoms line up with quantized kernel regressions after the 2026-02-14 qkernel patch.

jake (platform): tagging dpool-43, moving to isolation mode for tenant trd-993. We'll pull it off autoscale to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

lina (solutions): pinging TridentHealth PM on support channel, flagging potential customer-visible latency/5xxs. @k.mishra can you join?

k.mishra (acct-mgr): joining now. I’m messaging the customer that we have an incident and are doing a circuit-level mitigation. ETA for update 15m.

maya (oncall-sre): quick assessment: 5xxs spike correlates with requests hitting quantized kernels under sequence lengths >1024. Repro locally with heavy seq lengths.

samira (eng-runtime): confirm. The new qkernel path has a fallback race when KV cache gets fragmented. Workaround: route TridentHealth to the safe fp variant gpt-med-v1.4-safe (non-quant) or the older quant variant v1.3-quant. Recommend pin to safe (fp) to restore stability.

jake (platform): can do a tenant-level pin. Propose: 1) Pin trd-993 to gpt-med-v1.4-safe 2) Start a canary on 10% traffic -> monitor 3) Gradual ramp to 100% if stable.

maya (oncall-sre): +1. Need quick command and rollback plan.

samira (eng-runtime): here's the internal runbook snippet:

```
# pin tenant to model variant
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant trd-993 --pin-model gpt-med-v1.4-safe --reason "prod incident: qkernel regression"
# verify route
redwoodctl routes get --tenant trd-993
# start canary
redwoodctl traffic-split --tenant trd-993 --model gpt-med-v1.4-safe --percent 10
```

jake (platform): executing step 1 now. I’ll post deploy-bot output.

deploy-bot: starting operation: tenant-pin trd-993 -> gpt-med-v1.4-safe by jake at 2026-02-15T10:48:12Z

deploy-bot: operation status: partial-success. Control-plane updated. Edge routing propagation in progress (~30s).

maya (oncall-sre): watch metrics: 5xx rate, p95 latency, KV cache miss. hooking grafana links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/trd-993/tenant-health

samira (eng-runtime): quick check: worker logs show reduced OOMs on pinned nodes. Good sign. Keep canary at 10% for now, check for error rate stabilization.

k.mishra (acct-mgr): TridentHealth updated: "You've been routed to a stable model variant; our engineers are monitoring. We'll confirm when fully stable." Customer replies: "Thanks — some requests still 500ing intermittently."

maya (oncall-sre): noticing drop in 5xxs from 6.2% -> 1.1% within 3min after canary. p95 latency down 18%.

samira (eng-runtime): recommend ramp: 10 -> 50% now, wait 5m, then -> 100% if metrics hold. Rolling increase to avoid sudden load on fp variant.

jake (platform): executing traffic-split 50%...

deploy-bot: traffic-split applied: trd-993 -> gpt-med-v1.4-safe 50% at 2026-02-15T10:53:05Z

maya (oncall-sre): metrics at +7m: 5xx steady ~0.9%, p95 stable. No new OOMs reported.

samira (eng-runtime): file created for regression triage: reg-2026-02-trd-qkernel. We'll pin this tenant until qkernel patch reverts or a targeted fix lands.

jake (platform): proceeding to ramp to 100%. finalizing routing update.

deploy-bot: traffic-split applied: trd-993 -> gpt-med-v1.4-safe 100% at 2026-02-15T10:57:42Z

k.mishra (acct-mgr): customer confirms a return to normal for most flows, still asking if this will be permanent.

samira (eng-runtime): Not permanent — this is a safety pin. Plan: keep pinned and on a short maintenance window. We will either: a) roll back qkernel patch with a targeted revert, or b) land microfix with quant kernel guard. ETA for dev fix: 24–48h.

maya (oncall-sre): documenting in incident ticket INC-2026-TRD-09. Adding timeline, commands executed, and monitoring links.

lina (solutions): creating customer follow-up doc: what changed, why we pinned, and next steps. will include app-level mitigations if they want to limit seq length as temporary measure.

samira (eng-runtime): to engineers: reproduction steps in reg ticket include load pattern and seq lengths. If we can't backport safe fix quickly, we'll prepare a performance guidance doc for TridentHealth to avoid heavy >1024 seqs where possible.

maya (oncall-sre): status: mitigated -> customer routed to stable variant, on monitoring. assigning follow-up to eng-runtime for regression fix and to platform for post-incident rollout plan.

k.mishra (acct-mgr): closing loop with customer: SEND at 2026-02-15T11:05:00Z.

samira (eng-runtime): timeline note: revert/diff for qkernel patch created at 2026-02-15T11:12Z. Engineers on the qkernel team assigned.

maya (oncall-sre): thanks everyone. I'll keep the incident open for now until regression fix lands, then we'll schedule a controlled unpin and regression test. :white_check_mark:
